answer: Counterparty diversity stops sybil farms. Each identity stakes 200 POA and needs 12 counterparties, none above 25% of volume. A farm's hundred identities rise like one plume of smoke, trading only with each other, and forfeit deposits. Forging 100 costs 100 x 12 x 40 POA, 48,000 per epoch, vs 300 reward each. An honest agent trades terrace by terrace with real partners, pays one deposit, keeps full rewards. Open registration is a relic.
